highlights: Press F2 in a local pane to open User Menu. Create or edit a command in a compact dialog, then save it directly to the selected menu. Rename remains under Files and has its own configurable shortcut.
Command history is wider and uses shell syntax colors. Multiline commands retain their line breaks and indentation when you select them to edit.
Press Tab to insert a tab character or Shift+Tab to outdent the current or selected lines in Text Editor. Both shortcuts are configurable.
